description: For a first-order theory \(T\) and sentence \(A\), \(T\models A\) if and only if \(T_0\models A\) for some finite \(T_0\subseteq T\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Theory.models_iff_finset_models.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {T : L.Theory} {φ : L.Sentence} :
  T ⊨ᵇ φ ↔ ∃ T0, ↑T0 ⊆ T ∧ ↑T0 ⊨ᵇ φ
